import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000009;
    
    static class Edge {
        int u, v, flow, cap;
        Edge(int u_, int v_, int f_, int c_) {
            u = u_; v = v_; flow = f_; cap = c_;
        }
    }
    
    static class Dinic {
        int S, T;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> g;
        ArrayList<Edge> e;
        int[] ptr, level;
        
        Dinic(int n, int s, int t) {
            S = s; T = t;
            g = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            e = new ArrayList<>();
            ptr = new int[n];
            level = new int[n];
        }
        
        void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
            g.get(u).add(e.size());
            e.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, c));
            g.get(v).add(e.size());
            e.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
        }
        
        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            level[S] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(S);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int id : g.get(u)) {
                    int v = e.get(id).v;
                    if (level[v] == -1 && e.get(id).flow < e.get(id).cap) {
                        level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.add(v);
                        if (v == T) return true;
                    }
                }
            }
            return false;
        }
        
        long dfs(int u, int f) {
            if (f == 0) return 0;
            if (u == T) return f;
            for (int i = ptr[u]; i < g.get(u).size(); i++) {
                int id = g.get(u).get(i);
                int v = e.get(id).v;
                if (level[v] != level[u] + 1) continue;
                long pushed = dfs(v, Math.min(f, e.get(id).cap - e.get(id).flow));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.get(id).flow += (int)pushed;
                    e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= (int)pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
                ptr[u]++;
            }
            return 0;
        }
        
        long maxflow() {
            long ans = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long pushed = dfs(S, INF);
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                    ans += pushed;
                }
            }
            return ans;
        }
    }
    
    static int n, m;
    static char[][] sci, rea;
    static int[][] danger;
    
    static boolean valid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < n && c < m;
    }
    
    static int idOf(int x, int y) {
        return 1 + m * x + y;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int deadline;
        n = sc.nextInt();
        deadline = sc.nextInt();
        deadline++;
        m = n;
        
        sci = new char[n][m];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            sci[i] = s.toCharArray();
        }
        
        rea = new char[n][m];
        danger = new int[n][m];
        Queue<int[]> q0 = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            rea[i] = s.toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                danger[i][j] = INF;
                if (rea[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q0.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    danger[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (!q0.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q0.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
                for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
                    if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) != 1) continue;
                    int nx = x + dx, ny = y + dy;
                    if (valid(nx, ny) && danger[nx][ny] == INF && sci[nx][ny] != 'Y') {
                        danger[nx][ny] = danger[x][y] + 1;
                        q0.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int src = 0;
        int snk = n * n + n * n + 1;
        Dinic flow = new Dinic(n * n * 2 + 2, src, snk);
        
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < m; y++) {
                if (sci[x][y] >= '1' && sci[x][y] <= '9')
                    flow.addEdge(src, idOf(x, y), sci[x][y] - '0');
                if (rea[x][y] >= '1' && rea[x][y] <= '9')
                    flow.addEdge(n * n + idOf(x, y), snk, rea[x][y] - '0');
                
                for (int X = 0; X < n; X++) {
                    for (int Y = 0; Y < m; Y++) {
                        if (sci[x][y] == 'Y' || sci[x][y] == 'Z' || rea[X][Y] == 'Y' || rea[X][Y] == 'Z')
                            continue;
                        
                        boolean[][] seen = new boolean[n][m];
                        Queue<int[]> q1 = new LinkedList<>();
                        q1.add(new int[]{x, y, 1});
                        seen[x][y] = true;
                        while (!q1.isEmpty()) {
                            int[] cur2 = q1.poll();
                            int cx = cur2[0], cy = cur2[1], tim = cur2[2];
                            if (cx == X && cy == Y) {
                                seen[X][Y] = true;
                                break;
                            }
                            if (tim >= danger[cx][cy] || tim >= deadline) continue;
                            for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
                                for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
                                    if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) != 1) continue;
                                    int nx = cx + dx, ny = cy + dy;
                                    if (valid(nx, ny) && !seen[nx][ny] &&
                                        sci[nx][ny] != 'Y' && sci[nx][ny] != 'Z' &&
                                        tim + 1 <= danger[nx][ny]) {
                                        seen[nx][ny] = true;
                                        q1.add(new int[]{nx, ny, tim + 1});
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (seen[X][Y])
                            flow.addEdge(idOf(x, y), n * n + idOf(X, Y), INF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(flow.maxflow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
